name: World Wonders (fan expansion for Catan)
description: The Island of Catan is rich with resources and beauty. The great nations meet upon the island for a decade-long festival of culture and trade... and a grand competition. Living solely off of the land, they must build the greatest society they can in a short time. To do this, the nations decide to recreate the Wonders of the Ancient World. But only one of each Wonder can exist, and there are only so many Wonders that the land can support!  This expansion, which has been in development for over...

name: In the Stocks (fan expansion for Carcassonne)
description: When a player draws a tile with stocks he must play it to an existing city. The player is free to deploy his follower  to the city or he may place a follower into the stocks.  A player is not obligated either to deploy a follower to the city or detain a follower in the stocks. If the tile cannot be played, it is removed from the game and a new tile drawn to replace it.  Approved by carcassonnecentral and carcassonne-forum

name: Ancient Times (fan expansion for Dominion)
description: This is an unofficial fan-made expansion, and is not affiliated with Donald X. Vaccarino or Rio Grande Games. Permission has been granted from Rio Grande Games and Donald X. Vaccarino to create a fan expansion, use any trademarks and copyrighted materials of Dominion and list  Ancient Time  on Board Game Geek.  This fan expansion focuses on deck stability, especially in turn 3 and 4, that is, early stage of a game. Also, it contains many trashers that help you build stable decks by throwing a...

name: 7 Dice Wonders
description: A Print And Play dice game based on  7 Wonders  by Antoine Bauza from Repos Production. The artwork (for the icons) is based on the original artwork by Miguel Coimbra.  This game was created for the "In-A-Tin" / "Express" Print-and-Play Design Contest - Discussion Thread and shall forever be a free print and play game, by a fan for other fans of the original.  It won the contest (1st Place ( Overall Game ))  Addt'l. categories: 1st Place  Best In-A-Tin Game  1st Place  Best Express Game  1st ...

name: Founders of Gloomhaven
description: Description from the publisher:  Founders of Gloomhaven is a competitive tile-placement, action-selection, city-building game in which each player controls a fantastical race working to build the city of Gloomhaven and gain influence over its residents. This is a standalone game set in the same universe as Gloomhaven. The events, however, take place hundreds of years before Gloomhaven and depict the original construction of the city.  In Founders of Gloomhaven, players use action cards to pla...

name: Azul
description: Introduced by the Moors, azulejos (originally white and blue ceramic tiles) were fully embraced by the Portuguese when their king Manuel I, on a visit to the Alhambra palace in Southern Spain, was mesmerized by the stunning beauty of the Moorish decorative tiles. The king, awestruck by the interior beauty of the Alhambra, immediately ordered that his own palace in Portugal be decorated with similar wall tiles. As a tile-laying artist, you have been challenged to embellish the walls of the Roy...

name: A Dream of Splendor in Song Dynasty
description: Background Amidst the vibrancy of the Song Dynasty, A Dream of Splendor places players in the shoes of ambitious entrepreneurs entrusted with the revival of a fading street in Bianjing. As the proprietor of a struggling restaurant, the challenge is twofold: astutely manage a 50-tael debt while revitalizing the once-thriving district. Your strategic decisions in resource management, shop construction, and menu refinement will either breathe life back into these forgotten alleys or consign them...

name: Frogmouth Fan Pack (fan expansion for Wingspan)
description: A mini expansion created by a fan focused on different species of frogmouth. The expansion includes 14 new birds and 1 new bonus card. As a curiosity all cards have a black background.

name: The Resistance
description: The Empire must fall. Our mission must succeed. By destroying their key bases, we will shatter Imperial strength and liberate our people. Yet spies have infiltrated our ranks, ready for sabotage. We must unmask them. In five nights we reshape destiny or die trying. We are the Resistance!  The Resistance is a party game of social deduction. It is designed for five to ten players, lasts about 30 minutes, and has no player elimination. The Resistance is inspired by Mafia/Werewolf, yet it is uniq...

name: King of New Tokyo
description: This is a version of the popular classic monster brawl game using only the components from a  piecepack . Players will roll the 4 piecepack dice trying to knock each other out, or to simply remain  king of the hill  long enough to score the right combination of coins and tiles to win!

name: Alaska (fan expansion for Ticket to Ride)
description: This map is an unofficial Fan made expansion. Symbols   Graphics Copyright   2004-2015 Days of Wonder, Inc. Produced with permission of Days of Wonder, for non-commercial use only.   This follows the principles of the basic Ticket to Ride game on a special board with special cards and rules. The object of the game is to gain the most points by travelling various routes and outwitting other players. You will need the train pieces and the train cards from either the US or Europe base games (or ...

name: 3rd World Labour: Pandemic Edition
description: Somewhere in a 3rd world country, you are a laborer who tries to survive daily without enough state welfare benefits. When a pandemic occurs, you have to decide to risk your life by working outside or staying safe at home without cash to spend.  In 3rd world labour, there are construction sites that players have to build them up. When the 4th building was completed, the richest player will be a winner. Yes, in the 3rd world country the richest man always wins.  Each round, players have to dec...

name: Grind House: Scythes Out
description: The secrets of Grind House deepen in this new expansion that promises greater rewards if you can stand the risk. The Host has opened a new wing of the mansion for you to come explore, and your invitation included a little something extra this time around. But did the other players receive another message too? You d better stay sharp if you want to win Scythes Out.  New Thematic Mechanic: Promised Inheritance tokens. The Host has invited you all with a promise, but you ll soon find, that some ...

name: Rolling Realms: Terraforming Mars Promo Pack
description: Expand your copy of Rolling Realms with this set of 6 promo cards, inspired by Terraforming Mars.  To play this realm you will use your dice to mark outlined cards. Cards are outlined by fulfilling conditions, based on the number of resources you gain. Play the other realms smart to maximize the number of outlined cards and gain the best rewards in this realm.   description from the publisher

name: Codenames
description: Two rival spymasters know the secret identities of 25 agents. Their teammates know the agents only by their codenames   single-word labels like  disease ,  Germany , and  carrot . Yes, carrot. It's a legitimate codename. Each spymaster wants their team to identify their agents first...without uncovering the assassin by mistake.  In Codenames, two teams compete to see who can make contact with all of their agents first. Lay out 25 cards, each bearing a single word. The spymasters look at a car...

name: Horizons of Spirit Island
description: Horizons of Spirit Island features the core mechanisms of Spirit Island, but features a new double-sided game board with a streamlined set-up, punchboard components, and five new Spirits designed to be ideal for those playing a Spirit Island game for the first time. These new Spirits are compatible with all existing Spirit Island components, but to play with expansions like Jagged Earth, you would need a copy of Spirit Island itself.

name: Metropolia
description: Welcome to the city of Machi Koro. You've just been elected Mayor. Congrats! Unfortunately the citizens have some pretty big demands: jobs, a theme park, a couple of cheese factories and maybe even a radio tower. A tough proposition since the city currently consists of a wheat field, a bakery and a single die.  Armed only with your trusty die and a dream, you must grow Machi Koro into the largest city in the region. You will need to collect income from developments, build public works, and st...

name: Agricola
description: Description originally from BoardgameNews  In Agricola, you're a farmer in a wooden shack with your spouse and little else. At first, on a turn, your family gets to take only two actions, one for you and one for your spouse, as might be found among all the possibilities on a farm: plowing fields; collecting materials; building fences, and so on. There are numerous choices available, and while the game progresses you'll have more and more, as each round a new action card is flipped over, offer...

name: Atolla Modulis (fan expansion for Funkenschlag)
description: Atolla Modulis is a free modular expansion to Friedemann Friese's Power Grid (aka Funkenschlag 2nd Ed.). The Atolla Modulis system allows players to play a different game every time as there are thousands of possible combinations! Other than the initial setup, the Atolla Modulis plays with the same rules as the base game. A copy of Funkenschlag/Powergrid is required to play this expansion.  For helpful hints on building your own version, visit the BGG Wiki page on Print and Play Games

name: Blood Rage
description: Life is Battle; Battle is Glory; Glory is ALL   In Blood Rage, players control the warriors, leader, and ship of their own Viking clan. Ragnar k has come and it s the end of the world! It s the Vikings  last chance to go down in a blaze of glory and secure their places in Valhalla at Odin s side! As a Viking you can pursue one of many pathways to glory. You can: invade and pillage the land for its rewards; crush your opponents in battle: fulfill quests: increase your clan's stats: or even die...
